parameters.content:
## GALLARDO — School Mail Intelligence
n8n orchestrates (filter, routing, attachments, validation, storage, notifications). The LLM only interprets and returns strict JSON.

**Setup:** fill in **Config**, keep the Gmail Trigger search query in sync with `allowed_senders`, attach the 4 credentials, set the error workflow in Settings.
See `workflows/school-mail-intelligence/README.md`.

nodes.name: Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: Coarse privacy pre-filter: only school mail enters n8n. Keep the Search query in sync with Config.allowed_senders (Config is the authoritative check). Simplify is off so body, HTML and attachments are available.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Single place for all non-secret settings. Other nodes read it with $('Config').first().json.

nodes.name: Is School Sender?
nodes.notes: Authoritative allowlist. Entries in allowed_senders are exact addresses or @domain. Non-matching emails are dropped here without error.

nodes.name: Loop Over Emails
nodes.notes: One email per iteration so attachments of different emails are never aggregated together.

nodes.name: Normalize Email
nodes.notes: Clean email fields. Uses the plain-text body, or the HTML body with tags stripped when there is no plain text. Keeps the attachment binaries for later.

nodes.name: Find Existing Row
nodes.notes: Deduplication lookup by message_id, before any LLM call. Always Output Data is on so an empty result still continues.

nodes.name: Already Processed?
nodes.notes: true: a successful row already exists, so skip (no LLM call). false: new email, or a previous attempt failed and can be retried.

nodes.name: Skip Duplicate
nodes.notes: Already processed. Back to the loop.

nodes.name: Has Attachments?
nodes.notes: No attachments: go straight to the LLM input.

nodes.name: Split Attachments
nodes.notes: One item per attachment with its route (pdf, docx, image, other). Small images (logos, signatures) and images beyond the limit are marked as skipped.

nodes.name: Route by Type
nodes.notes: Outputs: 0 PDF, 1 DOCX, 2 image, 3 unsupported or skipped.

nodes.name: Extract PDF Text
nodes.notes: Text layer only. Scanned PDFs return no text (no OCR in v1).

nodes.name: PDF Result
nodes.notes: Empty text means the PDF is probably scanned: status no_text.

nodes.name: PDF Failed
nodes.notes: The attachment could not be read. Recorded and processing continues.

nodes.name: Unzip DOCX
nodes.notes: A DOCX file is a ZIP archive. Its text lives in word/document.xml.

nodes.name: Read DOCX Text
nodes.notes: Extracts paragraphs from word/document.xml. Never throws; failures become status failed.

nodes.name: DOCX Failed
nodes.notes: The attachment could not be read. Recorded and processing continues.

nodes.name: Read Image
nodes.notes: Base64-encodes the image so it can be sent to the vision model.

nodes.name: Image Result
nodes.notes: Image is passed to the LLM as an image_url part.

nodes.name: Image Failed
nodes.notes: The attachment could not be read. Recorded and processing continues.

nodes.name: Unsupported Result
nodes.notes: Unsupported format or skipped image. Recorded, not analysed.

nodes.name: Merge Attachment Results
nodes.notes: Collects every attachment result of the current email. Single input: works with any mix of attachment types.

nodes.name: Aggregate Attachments
nodes.notes: One item per email with attachments[].

nodes.name: Build LLM Input
nodes.notes: Prompt + strict JSON schema + image parts. Truncates body and attachment text to the configured limits.

nodes.name: Analyze Email
nodes.notes: OpenRouter chat completion with response_format json_schema (strict). Interprets only; it does not control the flow.

nodes.name: Validate LLM Output
nodes.notes: Parses and validates the model JSON. Unusable output becomes processing_status llm_failed.

nodes.name: Build Failure Record
nodes.notes: The LLM call failed after retries. The email metadata is still recorded and the user is notified.

nodes.name: Build Sheet Row
nodes.notes: Flattens the result into exactly the sheet columns (used for both success and failure).

nodes.name: Save to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Append or update keyed on message_id: one row per email, idempotent. RAW keeps ids and dates as text.

assignments.name: text

nodes.name: Build Notification
nodes.notes: Plain-text Telegram message (no Markdown, so no escaping problems). Different wording when the LLM analysis failed.

nodes.name: Send Telegram
nodes.notes: Notification channel. Replace this node to use another channel.

parameters.text:
={{ (() => {
  const r = $('Build Sheet Row').first().json;
  const text = [
    '❌ No se pudo guardar en Google Sheets. Los datos de este correo NO están en la hoja.',
    'Error: ' + ($json.error?.message ?? $json.error ?? 'desconocido'),
    '',
    'Asunto: ' + r.subject,
    'Recibido: ' + r.email_received_at,
    'message_id: ' + r.message_id,
    'Estado: ' + r.processing_status,
    'Categoría: ' + r.category,
    '',
    r.summary,
    '',
    ...(r.important_information ? ['Información importante:', r.important_information, ''] : []),
    ...(r.actions_required ? ['Acciones requeridas:', r.actions_required, ''] : []),
    ...(r.dates ? ['Fechas:', r.dates, ''] : []),
    ...(r.deadlines ? ['Plazos:', r.deadlines, ''] : []),
    ...(r.attachment_analysis_status ? ['Adjuntos:', r.attachment_analysis_status, ''] : []),
    '',
    r.original_email_reference,
  ].join('\n');
  return text.length > 4000 ? text.slice(0, 3990) + '\n[...]' : text;
})() }}

nodes.name: Alert: Sheets Failed
nodes.notes: Google Sheets failed after retries: send the full processed content so nothing is lost.

nodes.name: Flag Sheets Failure
nodes.notes: Marks this email so the execution is failed once the loop has finished.

nodes.name: Any Sheets Failure?
nodes.notes: Runs after all emails. If any row could not be saved, fail the execution so it is visible (and the error workflow fires).

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Google Sheets write failed for message_id ' + $json.message_id + '. Data was sent to Telegram.' }}
